description: Report a credible user-reported or directly observed Replo defect, including API, MCP, or documentation defects. Pass projectId from list_projects. Include expected/actual behavior, reported or performed reproSteps, retry/workaround outcomes, and observed errors or request IDs in errorContext. Mark unknowns; never invent evidence, root cause, or severity. Exclude ordinary bad arguments, missing configuration, and fixable site-code mistakes. Omit credentials and unrelated customer data. Files feedback with Replo's team; continue helping with the user's task. Do not resubmit the same report after success.

description.description: Attempted task, expected/actual behavior, impact, retries/workarounds, and recurrence. Distinguish reported from observed facts; mark unknowns without guessing severity or cause.

reproSteps.description: Numbered reported or performed steps, labeled by source, with expected/actual behavior. State when unavailable; never invent reproduction.

title.description: Short headline describing the broken behavior.
